title: Fundamental class of a local complete intersection and detection of smoothness
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs a determinant map from the conormal differential sequence to the relative dualizing line. It proves that invertibility of this map forces the maximal-rank Jacobian condition for a local complete-intersection presentation. Both the fundamental class construction and the converse smoothness criterion are substantive obligations.
